decisions.reason: Requiring the visual object type to be stated does not change the review sequence or the number of questions required per level.
The object-type documentation instruction does not alter gradual progression or the curriculum-block basis for splitting related levels.
Stating each level's object type does not change how questions applicable to multiple levels are duplicated or assigned.
The source instruction concerns visual object representation and does not resolve or modify curriculum coverage or grade alignment.
The instruction to state the visual object type does not change the deferred C# random-generator requirement or its constraints.
